axes.source: Blender/scene: Z up, a machine faces +Y, origin on the ground under its centre
axes.gltf: glTF: +Y up, a machine faces -Z; Blender (x, y, z) = glTF (x, z, -y)
axes.to_scene: for the Z-up scene: rotate the loaded root by +PI/2 about X (root.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2)
axes.rotations: rotations about X have the same sign in both frames; pivot_m is in scene axes, pivot_gltf in glTF axes

vertex_colours: COLOR_0 holds grime (multiplies the base colour; white = clean)
